items.note: The eight-row schedule (cancel old scratch, central and side paths, restore), the net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, and the three-stage map (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) all follow lines 741-765. The plan never fixes h=100 or gives the neighbour and wire counts (767-782), but these are not needed for the lemma itself.

Frames D_v common to all incidences of a gate, edge operator D_v D_u^{-1}, the invariant stored = D_v(logical), commutation with the pointwise gate, and the result D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} on every role, including scratch roles, match 804-825.

Correctly states the nondegenerate labels built from triple indicators with <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, comparability, the single decreasing edge (center 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, the sum Wm-2N+2L, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation keeps the telescoping and the side-wire inclusion, but omits the stage labels and the per-edge residual table (899-1047) that actually verify comparability, the orthonormal-basis argument over F_2 (1073-1102), and any computation of the ratio.

s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m with the N source exceptions (2P_{U_a}, rank one) is stated and derived, and S1.1.6.3 gives the shear H<-H+D on every role. However, the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m appears only as 'the endpoint condition', the assignment of P_U to gates and sinks is never given, and the derivation omits both the rank formula for P_V-P_U (1158-1161) and the endpoint computation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m (1169-1171).

The phase frames C_U and the edge change as one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector are stated, and the method names the key mechanism (weight additive mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, Hadamard diagonalization). The formula s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and the endpoint corrections (Z_a, i^27) giving C^{tensor m} on every role are not stated, and no sub-step follows the proof at 1231-1315.

For the bit network the chain L_b/N=100/539<1/2, then deficit N-2L_b>0, then eta_b=339/22587335000000>20*2^{-50}, then s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} is complete; log m<20 is implicit in the displayed inequality. The complex half (s_c<W_c m, eta_c=73/19906842167500, s_c/W_c<m^sigma) is never stated or derived, although S2.3 uses s/W<=m^sigma.

The plan invokes linear-time controlled shifts, single-digit operations and cyclic row splitting in O(V), and notes that controlled shifts update a later field from earlier ones. It never states the lemmas' content, such as y->y+a(controls) mod q^b with b^{O(1)} offset preparation, or the list of elementary operations.

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 (topmost row, rightmost pivot, lower-triangular operations), the O(V) triangular transforms, the sandwich, and the three-update realization of each one of Pi with one interchange all follow 1375-1447. The statement omits that q is a fixed odd prime chosen to avoid the denominators and diagonal numerators (1397, 1413-1423).

Row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_M frames, interchange by D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum, and the fixed-tape O(V) parking all match 1491-1588. S1.1's statement drops the hypothesis of a row field divisible by W^k; it appears only in S1's motivation.

High-digit exchange to create rows, the base-m split with O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and binary padding to [q^e] with e=O(u) are as in the paper. The plan omits the zero-row padding to R'=W^k ceil(R/W^k) (1684-1690) that supplies the divisibility the power-width proposition needs, and its motivation instead credits the high digits with divisibility.

Basic identities, the per-edge kernel product, conjugation of the residual basis into standard position by F_2 row additions on whole slots, inverse children via (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D are all present. The conjugation identity P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} is described rather than written.

Eight conditional additions inducing (00 10)(01 11), the guard interval [10,2^{K-1}-11], the union bound giving delta_bad, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, swap-rotate-unswap cost, extraction and radix sort, and the final cost all follow 2016-2207. The separate handling of the top position j_{f-1} is omitted, which is minor.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks with range >=W^{k_0}, V/W children, the recurrence with leaves O(e), the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m assembly to O(d^{lambda'}) are present. The step that bounds the overhead by O(e^lambda) via K<=e^{c/beta} and tau(1+c/beta)<lambda (2413-2415) is missing, yet the plan asserts the internal sum O(e^lambda).

Taken across S2 and S2.4-S2.5, the plan has O(Vd^{lambda'}) cost, exact Gaussian dyadic evaluation with Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) guard bits from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, a single truncation, and error below sqrt2 2^{-p} with the disk preserved, matching 2457-2586 and 2686-2758.

Character cancellation by the halving shift, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage B_t, the reverse procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, grouped rounds, prefix moves O(TpdK), chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), simultaneous rounds and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} all match the paper.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the four products, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centered extraction with a carry in {0,1}, negacyclic reduction and the O(rp log(rp)) cost follow 3240-3367.
Retained LB order, the normalization identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the error chain 3delta+eta scaled by M, and the cost match 3414-3495.

The identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions, the Neumann inversion of N, the normalizations, the two sorts avoided, tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2, and the line costs are faithful. The permutations P_s, P_t (R, Q) are never defined (in particular the frequency multiplication by -s), and the axis-exposure cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) is not attached to this lemma.

Both identities and their proofs (coefficient comparison, F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+, normalized convolution rule) follow 3938-3983. The chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) itself is not given, and the conjugation route to RF^+ is not stated.

The exponent values, sizes, alpha, gamma, the prime-count bound, disjoint intervals, the Bernoulli estimate giving T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} search and the no-wraparound degree bound all match the paper.
Isomorphism via the order-S image of x, the triangular formula, descending update order, the padded-box bijection, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts and the O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) cost follow 4216-4292.
Well-definedness, the diagonal isometric isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, and the computed twist factors are all present.

Source transform (A, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma) with exact counterpart RF_s, the six-step algorithm, and the two scalings by S undoing (u*v)/S^2 match 4456-4541. The input scaling 2^{-b-2} is only implicit in 2^{2b+4}.

Disk margins, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, the opposite-transform error (3E_s+2)h_p via permutation cancellation, the final bound 448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using S<=T<2^b, L<b and gamma<=b/4, rounding, carries and the 2n-bit output match. The intermediate E_ring and chirp bounds are summarized into E_s.

All seven table rows with their powers and margins, min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, the o(V) setup, the absorption of powers of log p, and the schoolbook cutoff match the paper. S7.10 slightly misattributes why exceptional sorting is o(V).
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n optimality conjecture in this model, but gives neither the eventual-lower-bound formulation nor the liminf argument of 381-387.

errors.says: Each edge change is a product of two-point kernels C=HSH=aI+bX, described as 'translations of the array'.
errors.paper: The kernels are aI+bX_v, a combination of the identity and the translation X_v (f(x)->f(x+v)), not translations themselves.

errors.says: Motivation: the row field divisible by W^k is supplied for general arrays by the chunk's own high digits.
errors.paper: The high digits give R=q^{2rho}>=W^k rows; zero rows are then appended to reach R'=W^k ceil(R/W^k), which supplies the divisibility.

errors.says: Setup, prime search and the compact sorting of exceptional records are o(V) because the number of visits is polynomial in p while r exceeds every fixed power of p.
errors.paper: Exceptional sorting is O(Vp^{A'}2^{-K})=o(V) because K=Theta(p^{eps c}); prime search is o(n) because its cost is n^{o(1)}. Only setup per node and per record relies on r.

errors.says: A fixed network of XOR gates exchanges two banks X,Y (up to a sign); its sub-steps also cover the complex case.
errors.paper: Only the bit construction is over F_2. The complex construction has scalars in Z[i,1/2] with coefficients (|S cap T|-1)/2 and 1/2, and it is the complex case that carries the sign.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. The bit-network interchange (S1) and the complex-network layer (S2) feed the transform layout (S3), the ring convolution (S4), resampling and chirp (S5), and the assembly with exact recovery (S6), and they end in the margin table with min g_i=2kappa (S7). It thins at the rational and phase interfaces: the bit endpoint identity M_sink-M_source=I_m is only named and the complex rank sum s_c and the endpoint corrections are omitted. It also thins at the layer overhead bound via K<=e^{c/beta} and at the zero-row padding that makes the row count divisible by W^k. Nothing in the tree contradicts the paper.

steps.note: The fixed linear network on triples of [h] with the signed exchange (x,y)->(-y,x) and restoration of every auxiliary wire is stated with its mechanism. The plan never gives h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 or the indexing of X_a,Y_a by triples, so the size parameters are only used, not defined.
Common frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, edge cost a change of frame, and D_out S D_in^{-1} with intermediate frames free are all present.
Nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional tensor space of triple indicators, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decrease on central wires 3->4 losing h are stated.

S1.1.4.4 states that matrix rank equals the dimension change except at the N negative source projections, whose edge matrix 2P_{U_a} has rank one. The assignment P_U at gates and the rank formula for P_V-P_U are only implicit.
Signed sum Wm-2N, L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are all explicit.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, and deficit N-2L_b>0 giving s_b<W_b m are stated.

The consequence (Phi_{I_m}, the shear H<-H+D on every role including scratch) is stated, but the identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m is only called 'the endpoint condition'. Its source (-P_{U_a} at X_a sources, P_{U_a^perp} at Y_a sinks, 0 and I elsewhere) is never given, so the conservative verdict is mentioned.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node are explicit.

Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta_b>20*2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta) giving s/W<m^tau, tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau) are present. log m<20 is implicit in the displayed inequality.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the chain behind the central saving almost completely: network, frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L with s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539<1/2, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The weak link is the endpoint identity: the plan names the endpoint condition and states its effect, the shear H<-H+D on every role, but never writes M_sink-M_source=I_m or the source and sink matrices that produce it. The size parameters h=100, N and m are used but never defined.
